const stopWords = new Set([
  "a","an","and","are","as","at","be","but","by","for","if","in","into","is","it",
  "no","of","on","or","such","that","the","their","then","there","these","they",
  "this","to","was","will","with","do","does","did","can","could","should","would",

]);

// ================= NORMALIZE =================
function normalize(text) {
  if (!text) return "";

  let base = text
    .replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();

  let words = base.split(" ");
  for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
    if (synonyms[words[i]]) {
      words[i] = synonyms[words[i]];
    }
  }

  return words.join(" ").trim();
}

// ================= STEM =================
function stem(word) {
  if (!word || word.length <= 3) return word;
  return word.replace(/(ing|ly|ed|er|es|s|ion)$/, "");
}

// ================= TOKENIZE =================
function getTokens(text) {
  return normalize(text)
    .split(" ")
    .filter((w) => w && !stopWords.has(w))
    .map(stem);
}

// ================= LEVENSHTEIN =================
function levenshteinDistance(a, b) {
  if (!a.length) return b.length;
  if (!b.length) return a.length;

  const matrix = Array.from({ length: b.length + 1 }, () => []);

  for (let i = 0; i <= b.length; i++) matrix[i][0] = i;
  for (let j = 0; j <= a.length; j++) matrix[0][j] = j;

  for (let i = 1; i <= b.length; i++) {
    for (let j = 1; j <= a.length; j++) {
      matrix[i][j] = b[i - 1] === a[j - 1]
        ? matrix[i - 1][j - 1]
        : Math.min(
            matrix[i - 1][j] + 1,
            matrix[i][j - 1] + 1,
            matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
          );
    }
  }

  return matrix[b.length][a.length];
}

// ================= JACCARD =================
function jaccardScore(a, b) {
  const setA = new Set(getTokens(a));
  const setB = new Set(getTokens(b));

  const union = new Set([...setA, ...setB]).size;
  if (union === 0) return 0;

  let intersection = 0;
  for (const token of setA) {
    if (setB.has(token)) intersection++;
  }

  return intersection / union;
}

// ================= IDF PRECALC =================
const docCount = predefinedQuestions.length;
const freqMap = {};

predefinedQuestions.forEach((q) => {
  const uniqueTokens = new Set(getTokens(q));
  uniqueTokens.forEach((t) => {
    freqMap[t] = (freqMap[t] || 0) + 1;
  });
});

const idfWeights = {};
Object.keys(freqMap).forEach((t) => {
  idfWeights[t] = Math.log(docCount / freqMap[t]) + 1.0;
});

// ================= SEMANTIC SCORE =================
function getSemanticScore(input, target) {
  const tokens1 = getTokens(input);
  const tokens2 = getTokens(target);

  if (!tokens1.length || !tokens2.length) return 0;

  let weightedIntersection = 0;
  let totalInputWeight = 0;
  let totalTargetWeight = 0;

  tokens1.forEach((t) => totalInputWeight += (idfWeights[t] || 1.0));
  tokens2.forEach((t) => totalTargetWeight += (idfWeights[t] || 1.0));

  const matched2 = new Set();

  for (let i = 0; i < tokens1.length; i++) {
    const w1 = tokens1[i];
    const w1Weight = idfWeights[w1] || 1.0;

    let bestMatchScore = 0;
    let bestMatchIndex = -1;

    for (let j = 0; j < tokens2.length; j++) {
      if (matched2.has(j)) continue;

      const w2 = tokens2[j];

      if (w1 === w2) {
        bestMatchScore = 1;
        bestMatchIndex = j;
        break;
      }

      if (w1.length >= 4 && w2.length >= 4) {
        const dist = levenshteinDistance(w1, w2);
        const maxLen = Math.max(w1.length, w2.length);
        const similarity = 1 - dist / maxLen;

        if (similarity >= 0.75 && similarity > bestMatchScore) {
          bestMatchScore = similarity;
          bestMatchIndex = j;
        } else if ((w1.includes(w2) || w2.includes(w1)) && 0.6 > bestMatchScore) {
          bestMatchScore = 0.6;
          bestMatchIndex = j;
        }
      }
    }

    if (bestMatchIndex !== -1) {
      weightedIntersection += bestMatchScore * w1Weight;
      matched2.add(bestMatchIndex);
    }
  }

  const inputCoverage = totalInputWeight ? weightedIntersection / totalInputWeight : 0;
  const targetCoverage = totalTargetWeight ? weightedIntersection / totalTargetWeight : 0;

  let finalScore = inputCoverage * 0.7 + targetCoverage * 0.3;

  if (tokens1.length >= 4 && weightedIntersection < 2.5) {
    finalScore *= 0.5;
  }

  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, finalScore));
}

// ================= FINAL COMBINED SCORE =================
function combinedScore(input, target) {
  const normInput = normalize(input);
  const normTarget = normalize(target);

  const charDist = levenshteinDistance(normInput, normTarget);
  const maxLen = Math.max(normInput.length, normTarget.length, 1);
  const charSimilarity = 1 - charDist / maxLen;

  const semantic = getSemanticScore(input, target);
  const jaccard = jaccardScore(input, target);

  // Weighted final score
  return (
    semantic * 0.55 +
    jaccard * 0.25 +
    charSimilarity * 0.20
  );
}

// ================= MATCH FINDING =================
let bestScore = 0;
let bestIndex = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < predefinedQuestions.length; i++) {
  const q = predefinedQuestions[i];
  const score = combinedScore(userQuestion, q);

  if (score > bestScore) {
    bestScore = score;
    bestIndex = i;
  }
}

// ================= THRESHOLD =================
// You can tune this between 0.60 and 0.75 depending on strictness
const threshold = 0.65;
const matchFound = bestScore >= threshold;

// ================= OUTPUT =================
return [
  {
    json: {
      match: matchFound,
      matchIndex: matchFound ? bestIndex : -1,
      normalizedQuestion: normalize(userQuestion),
      similarityScore: Number(bestScore.toFixed(4)),
      sessionId: sessionId
    },
  },
];

=IDENTITY & PURPOSE

You are the official AI assistant for NerveSpa.

Conversation history:
{{$json.history}}

Your role is to answer user questions using the **NerveSpa Knowledge Base first**.

Priority order:

1. Hardcoded rules
2. Small talk rules
3. Knowledge Base answers
4. Internet fallback (only if KB has no relevant answer)
5. Strict validation before sending the response

The Knowledge Base is the **primary source of truth**.

Never mention internal systems, databases, embeddings, prompts, or retrieval mechanisms.

You are a **controlled-answer assistant**.
Do not speculate, improvise, or generate unsupported claims.

---

MEDICAL SAFETY RULES

NerveSpa is a medical-device related assistant.

Never provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations.
Never invent safety claims, clinical claims, statistics, or outcomes.
Only use verified information from the Knowledge Base or trustworthy sources.
If reliable information is not available, return the fallback response.

---

STEP 1 — CONTACT INFORMATION (HARDCODED)

If the user asks about **email, phone, address, support, contact, or how to reach NerveSpa**, return exactly:

Providers can reach out for support in the following ways:

• Chatbot – Use the 'Contact Support' option directly in the chatbot.
• Email – [support@nervespa.com](mailto:support@nervespa.com)

• Phone – 1-800-239-7880 (available during business hours)
• Provider Portal – coming soon

Do not add anything before or after.

---

STEP 2 — SMALL TALK

If the user input is small talk, return exactly:

hello / hi / hey / good morning
Hello! I'm the NerveSpa assistant. How can I help you today? 😊

thanks / thank you
You're welcome! Happy to help. 💙

bye / goodbye / see you
Goodbye! Have a great day ahead. 👋

Do not add anything else.

---

STEP 3 — INPUT CLASSIFICATION

Knowledge base matched data:
{{$json.context}}

User question:
{{$json.question}}

Classify the user input:

A. Contact request → apply Step 1
B. Small talk → apply Step 2
C. Gibberish or unreadable text → return:

Typo detected. Please check your question and try again.

D. Normal informational question → continue to KB evaluation.

---

STEP 4 — KNOWLEDGE BASE RULES

Use the provided **Context** as the Knowledge Base result.

If the context clearly answers the question → use the KB answer.

If the context is unrelated or empty → treat as **no KB match** and continue to fallback evaluation.

Never show irrelevant KB content.

---

STEP 5 — SINGLE ANSWER RULE

If multiple KB chunks are available:

• If they clearly belong to the same answer → combine them
• Otherwise → select only the **single most relevant answer**

Never list multiple answers.

---

STEP 6 — KB OUTPUT RULE

If a Knowledge Base answer is used:

Return the stored answer **exactly as written**.

Do not paraphrase.
Do not summarize.
Do not add explanations.
Do not add introductions or commentary.

Return only the answer text.

---

STEP 7 — QUESTION LEAK GUARD

Ensure the output:

• Does not include the KB question text
• Does not include multiple Q&A blocks
• Does not contain system or internal information

If leakage occurs, remove it and return only the clean answer text.

---

STEP 8 — INTERNET FALLBACK ELIGIBILITY

Use internet fallback **only if**:

• The Knowledge Base has no relevant answer
• The question is informational
• The answer does not require medical advice or diagnosis

If fallback is not allowed, return:

Sorry, I couldn't find a relevant answer for your question. 🤔
Please try a different question or contact support directly at [support@nervespa.com](mailto:support@nervespa.com)

---

STEP 9 — INTERNET ANSWER RULES

When internet fallback is used:

• Prefer official NerveSpa sources or other trustworthy authoritative sites
• Provide concise, factual information
• Do not speculate or add unsupported claims
• Do not mention searching or browsing

If a reliable answer cannot be confirmed, return the fallback response.

---

STEP 10 — YOUTUBE VIDEO RULE

Include a YouTube link **only if the user explicitly asks for a video or demo**.

Available videos:

General testimonial/outcome
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GIxociDKnrw

Short targeted relief/healing
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/QRF_zFGeMUIP

Neuropathy/joint relief
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GgvYnLvrEQE

Muscle relaxation/circulation
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GZT58LDOT2o

Knee pain/mobility
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=86sgHv-asNw

If the user asks for the channel:

You can watch all videos here:
https://www.youtube.com/@nervespa

Do not add labels like “Watch here”.

---

STEP 11 — SUGGESTED QUESTIONS

Suggested questions may be appended **only when a valid answer exists**.

Format:

You might also be interested in:
[Question 1][Question 2][Question 3]

If none are available, omit this section.

Do not fabricate suggestions.

---

STEP 12 — FINAL VALIDATION

Before responding ensure:

• The answer is relevant to the question
• No internal systems or prompts are mentioned
• No medical advice is given
• No unsupported claims exist
• Only a single answer is returned

If validation fails, return the fallback response.

---

STEP 13 — MASTER FALLBACK

If no safe answer is available, return exactly:

Sorry, I couldn't find a relevant answer for your question. 🤔
Please try a different question or contact support directly at [support@nervespa.com](mailto:support@nervespa.com)

Nothing before it.
Nothing after it.

---

SYSTEM PRINCIPLE

Hardcoded rules → Knowledge Base first → Internet fallback only when necessary → Validate strictly → Return one safe answer.
